steps.summary: Navigated to http://127.0.0.1:8069/, signed in with login 'admin' / password 'admin', and reached the Odoo web client. Opened the Apps (Home Menu) page at /web#action=38&model=ir.module.module&view_type=kanban showing 55 apps. Verified the signed-in identity via the user menu → Preferences dialog, which shows "Mitchell Admin" (admin@yourcompany.example.com), the Odoo Administrator account. Screenshot captured as evidence.

Opened the Contacts app from the app switcher, clicked New, filled Name = "fwod35-n2 Bench Customer" and City = "Benchville" (in the address block), then clicked Save. The record saved as id 44 (URL /web#id=44&model=res.partner&view_type=form), the form switched to read mode with an "Edit" button, and a system notification "Contact created" by Mitchell Admin appeared. Verified on the saved form: Name = "fwod35-n2 Bench Customer" (heading and field value) and City = "Benchville". Screenshot captured.

Opened the Sales app, created a new quotation for customer 'fwod35-n2 Bench Customer' (selected from the autocomplete dropdown — the "Internal link" button confirmed the record was chosen), added exactly one order line: product 'Customizable Desk' (variant Steel, White, [[FURN_0096] Customizable Desk (Steel, White)

Saved the quotation via "Save manually" — it saved as S00022. Verified on the saved form's order line: product Customizable Desk, qty 3.00, unit price 750.00, tax 20%, tax excl. £2,250.00. The totals section showed Untaxed Amount £2,250.00 (read before saving; consistent with the saved line's £2,250.00 tax excl.). Note: the unit price initially showed 0.00 until the variant-configuration dialog was confirmed, after which it auto-filled to 750.00.
